description: Track list for a mood + minutes with per-track sync-license quotes and terms. Data only: quotes are not licenses. Price: $0.10 USDC on Base via x402 (the live 402 challenge is authoritative). Two-phase flow: a first call without 'payment' returns the live payment requirements (payTo, amount, accepted networks); after payment from the caller's own wallet, a second call with 'payment' set to the base64-encoded x402 payload returns the data in the tool result. This tool never pays, never touches private keys, and never holds funds. Resale of the data output is permitted at the reseller's own price.

mood.description: sleep | focus | meditate | calm | deep (default sleep).

payment.description: Base64-encoded x402 v1 payment payload (the signed ExactEvmPayload JSON). Absent on the first call, which receives the payment requirements; present on the follow-up call, after signing in the caller's own wallet / x402 client. The server only forwards it to the rail — it never signs, never holds funds, never touches private keys.

name: qm_playlist_build
